decisions.reason: The black-finish drainage range fits the firm's design-led core offer and supports current bathroom aesthetics with limited strategic risk.
The shower channel for seamless coverings matches strong demand for modern, barrier-free bathroom design and sits very close to the firm's established drainage expertise.
The pump-assisted shower drainage solution extends the firm's technical problem-solving offer for more difficult installation situations and supports future-ready renovation needs.
The tileable floor drain with grating is a natural extension of the core portfolio and aligns well with the firm's focus on attractive, reliable integrated drainage.
The stainless steel design drain grate strengthens the firm's broad, design-oriented range and is easy to support through existing production and sales channels.
